title: Wanna bet?
heading: Wanna bet?
coreClaim: The chapter argues that beliefs are more honest and useful when expressed as bets, because pricing a claim exposes how much confidence is really behind it.
distinctMechanism: Bet language turns declarations into measurable commitments, which reveals overconfidence and improves calibration in disagreement.
requiredAnchors: The gap between what people say confidently and what they would actually stake.
Bet language as a way to make belief strength visible.
commonMisreadings: The chapter is pushing literal gambling.
Bet language is mainly a status move.
specificApplications: Price a forecast instead of asserting it vaguely.
Use stake language to improve disagreement and self-audit.
Expose the difference between posture and conviction.
hardEdgeRequirement: Preserve the distinction between honest calibration and performative aggression.
thresholdQuestion: How does a real or simulated stake reveal the true strength of a belief?
